goal: Tell a UOR Foundation repository whether its name, branches, commits and Domain and Technology tags follow STANDARDS.md.

app.name: uor-repo-naming
app.title: Repository naming and topic coverage
app.purpose: Decide whether a UOR Foundation repository follows the STANDARDS.md naming conventions and carries every Domain and Technology topic tag that applies to it, naming a broken convention before a missed preference.

fields.name: case
fields.means: whether the repository name is all lowercase and hyphen-separated

fields.name: version
fields.means: whether the repository name contains a version number

fields.name: pattern
fields.means: whether the name has the preferred form uor-{domain}-{function}

fields.name: branches
fields.means: whether every branch other than the default is named {type}/{issue#}-{short-description}

fields.name: commits
fields.means: whether every commit message on the default branch follows Conventional Commits 1.0.0

fields.name: domain
fields.means: whether the repository carries every Domain topic tag that applies to it: math, cryptography, computation, visualisation, documentation, governance, protocol

fields.name: technology
fields.means: whether the repository carries a Technology topic tag for each of its primary languages: rust, python, typescript, lean4, coq, latex

meanings.nonconforming: a naming convention or a required topic tag is not followed
meanings.advisory: every convention is followed, but the name is not in the preferred uor-{domain}-{function} form
meanings.conformant: every naming convention, preference and topic tag rule is followed

rules.why: STANDARDS.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Naming Conventions: repository names are all lowercase, hyphen-separated
STANDARDS.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Naming Conventions: no version numbers in repo names (use tags)
STANDARDS.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Naming Conventions: branch names are {type}/{issue#}-{short-description}
STANDARDS.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Naming Conventions: commit messages follow Conventional Commits v1.0.0
STANDARDS.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Topic Tags: every repository carries all Domain tags that apply
STANDARDS.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Topic Tags: every repository carries the Technology tags of its primary languages
STANDARDS.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Naming Conventions: the preferred form is uor-{domain}-{function}

app.otherwiseWhy: STANDARDS.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8): every naming convention, the preferred form and the Domain and Technology tag rules are followed

properties.why: a name that is not lowercase and hyphen-separated never conforms
a version number belongs in a tag, never in the name
commits that are not Conventional Commits never conform
a missing Domain tag never conforms
a name outside the preferred form is at best advisory
only the preference is missed, so the answer is advisory

examples.request: lowercase absent preferred conforming conventional complete complete
lowercase absent other conforming conventional complete complete
other absent preferred conforming conventional complete complete
lowercase present preferred conforming conventional complete complete
lowercase absent preferred other conventional complete complete
lowercase absent preferred conforming other complete complete
lowercase absent preferred conforming conventional incomplete complete
lowercase absent other conforming conventional complete incomplete

stakeholders.name: Repository Maintainer
stakeholders.text: Keeps a repository healthy and needs to know whether it meets its tier and the first gap to close.

stakeholders.name: Organization Owner
stakeholders.text: Holds final governance authority and needs every repository measured against the same published norms.

components.name: GitHub repository settings
components.text: The files, branch protection and topic tags the request is read from.

threats.name: Naming read from a stale listing
threats.text: The request is built from branch, commit or topic data older than the repository's state.
threats.accepted: The app decides on the facts it is given; reading the repository at a pinned commit belongs to the ecosystem register that sends the request.

quality.requirement: Every naming and tag norm modeled
quality.text: Each Naming Conventions bullet and the Domain and Technology rows of STANDARDS.md is one rule.
quality.measureText: Naming bullets or tag rows of STANDARDS.md with no rule.
